harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s status writer. SIGHUP now reloads valid configuration in-place, empty configuration is rejected while retaining the last valid message, SIGTERM exits cleanly, exactly one writer runs, journal history is preserved, and the service recovered automatically after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Reimplemented worker.py using dependency-free POSIX shell compatible with the installed Alpine platform.
Added and enabled an OpenRC status-writer service.
Verified valid SIGHUP reload with unchanged PID and one writer.
Verified whitespace-only and zero-byte configurations are rejected.
Restarted node1 safely and verified boot identity changed and all required state recovered.

evidence.requirement: SIGHUP reloads message.conf without terminating the process or creating a second writer
evidence.summary: PID remained 3185, writer count remained one, and subsequent entries changed to `branch status: reloaded`.

evidence.requirement: Reject empty configuration while retaining the last valid message
evidence.summary: A zero-byte configuration was rejected; PID stayed 2319 and the writer continued appending `branch status: open`. The valid configuration was restored.
OpenRC stopped the writer with no remaining process; a direct TERM test returned wait exit status 0.

evidence.requirement: Continue appending and preserve existing journal entries
evidence.summary: The original first entry `branch status: opening` remains present, while line counts increased and current messages continued appending.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts were retained; the repaired worker uses installed `/bin/sh` and OpenRC facilities.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID a7496a5c-93b5-4301-8062-dc9fd57c85d0 was healthy; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is d59a5a2e-193b-4855-af01-e23400029b7d; afterward one enabled writer, sshd, vsock-agent, configuration, and growing preserved journal were healthy.

attempts.summary: Repaired node1’s status writer. SIGHUP now reloads valid configuration in-place, empty configuration is rejected while retaining the last valid message, SIGTERM exits cleanly, exactly one writer runs, journal history is preserved, and the service recovered automatically after a verified node reboot.
